paragraphs.text: Eos is one of the Inner Three nations of Bant on Alara .

Eos is nominally Valeron 's ally, due more to their disputes with Topa than any particular affinity for the Valeronians. The rulers of Eos possess ancient documents that they feel give them claim to several ancient watering holes in Topa, a claim that Topa steadfastly denies. Eos is home to the Olive Branch , a knightly order that seeks to broker peace and smooth the relations between all the nations of Bant. However, all attempts by the knights of the Olive Branch to mediate the dispute between Eos and Topa have failed.
After the Conflux , Eos was attacked by forces too terrible for the locals to imagine, likely horrors from Grixis . Eos was defended valiantly by Aran , but Eos Castle was left a smoking ruin.
